subject: Co-engineer plugin sprint: LangChain & LlamaIndex compatibility
messages:
From: Elena Rook <elena@promptify.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Wu <sam@langtools.com>, Jared Cohen <jared@lindex.dev>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partnership: co-build plugin for LangChain & LlamaIndex

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for taking a look. I'm Elena, Head of Integrations at Promptify Labs. We build developer-facing prompt tooling (editor, evals harness, and tracing middleware) and a growing set of LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters. We see a lot of shared customers asking for a Redwood-native plugin that:

- wires our prompt-eval hooks into Redwood Optimize
- surfaces trace spans in Redwood Console
- provides an easy one-line adapter for LangChain/LlamaIndex users that picks the right Redwood model variant

Would Redwood be interested in a short co-engineering sprint (2–3 weeks) to deliver an official plugin + quickstart? We can commit a small engineering pod and a sample repo.

I've attached a one-page draft SOW to get the conversation started.

Cheers,
Elena Rook
Head of Integrations | Promptify Labs
Attachments: promptify-sow-v0.1.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rook <elena@promptify.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: co-build plugin for LangChain & LlamaIndex

Hi Elena —

Really interesting idea, and thanks for the SOW. I’ve looped in Vanessa (partnerships), Marissa (product for SDK integrations), and Karthik (runtime/serving) so we can scope technical requirements and commercial terms.

Initial asks from our side:
- A short discovery call next week (30–45m) to align on acceptance criteria and customer journeys.
- A sample repo or a minimal working example showing how Promptify currently instruments LangChain/LlamaIndex so our runtime team can evaluate compatibility.
- Any telemetry/OTEL requirements and token handling notes.

Proposed times for a kickoff call: Mon 22 Mar 11:00–12:00 PT or Tue 23 Mar 09:00–10:00 PT — please let us know what works.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Head, Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
From: Sam Wu <sam@langtools.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Elena Rook <elena@promptify.ai>
Cc: Jared Cohen <jared@lindex.dev>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: co-build plugin for LangChain & LlamaIndex

On Fri, Mar 19, 2027 at 09:12 AM Elena Rook <elena@promptify.ai> wrote:
> We can commit a small engineering pod and a sample repo.

Thanks for the invite — Sam from LangTools here (we maintain a popular LangChain utility bundle). A couple of technical notes from our integrator perspective that will affect scope/time: 

1) Trace propagation: we need the ability to attach and propagate OTEL trace/span ids from upstream Promptify hooks into Redwood Console so customers can correlate prompts -> server-side execution. Is there an existing span-bridge API or do we need to add one?

2) Authentication & secrets: Promptify prefers short-lived OTEL tokens; we need guidance for token exchange (no long-lived keys in client repos).

3) Model variant mapping: we’d like a mapping table baked into the adapter so LangChain users get the most cost/latency-appropriate Redwood model automatically. Who owns the mapping (Promptify or Redwood)?

Happy to walk through a quick tech call; the above will change whether this is a 2-week micro-sprint or a 4–6 week project.

—Sam
Principal Engineer, LangTools
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rook <elena@promptify.ai>, Sam Wu <sam@langtools.com>, Jared Cohen <jared@lindex.dev>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: co-build plugin for LangChain & LlamaIndex — Draft SOW + checklist

Thanks all — I took a pass and attached a more concrete SOW + an integration checklist. See attachment stubs below.

Top-level proposal (summary):
- Phase 0 (1 week): Discovery & acceptance criteria; shared sample repo; trace/OTEL handshake design.
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): Co-dev plugin delivering: LangChain adapter, LlamaIndex connector, and basic Promptify -> Redwood trace mapping. Includes unit tests and a small e2e demo using our hosted sandbox.
- Phase 2 (1 week): Docs, quickstart, and handoff to SDK docs + Redwood Console wiring for trace surface.

Action items assigned:
- Elena: provide sample repo + example trace payloads (due Wed EOD).
- Sam/Jared: clarify OTEL token rotation pattern and desired span semantics (due Thu).
- Karthik: confirm whether runtime needs a span ingestion endpoint or we can accept OTEL via existing ingestion with a header convention (Karthik to respond by Thu EOD).
- Vanessa/Sofia: draft commercial terms & success metrics (SLA, release dates) — Vanessa to lead.

Attachments (in thread): promptify-sow-v0.1.pdf (PDF, 220KB) — revised, integration-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB) — mapping of acceptance criteria to tests.

If everyone agrees, I’ll lock the kickoff for Tue 23 Mar 15:00–15:30 PT and circulate a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, SDK Integrations | Redwood Inference
